runs.quote: The report lists each department with its volunteer count, total hours, average donation, and the month name of the earliest join date in that department.
runs.why: If no rows qualify (all filtered or no data), no departments are listed, so the output is just the header with its trailing newline — the blank line in the example belongs to the department block, not the header.

runs.quote: Only rows with at least 10 hours are included in the summary.
runs.why: When all volunteers in a department have hours below 10, none are included, so that department must not appear in the summary at all — the KeyError indicates the solver failed to filter before building department records.
